issues.reason: Comparatives & degree defines (Ordinal <entity> <n> <scale>) with the scale being the associated event ('the first to respond' → (Ordinal priya 1 respond)) or an explicit '-est' dimension, so putting the ranked thing's own class column there fills the slot with something that is not an ordering.

A temporal 's-genitive on a non-eventive artifact is uncovered — the reviewer's own gap — and the mechanically licensed genitive would emit the false (Possession sk_edition_1 friday), whereas (Time sk_edition_1 (Weekday friday)) is true of the sentence's content and uses a well-formed Time term, so it is acceptable improvisation under the calibration line.

gaps_confirmed: a temporal 's-genitive ('Friday's edition') whose possessor is a date rather than an owner — the genitive rule yields a false Possession and the Time role is specified for eventualities
repair_summary: Changed the Ordinal scale from the entity's own class column to the associated event appear.
notes: The reviewer's second gap is not one: a proper noun with no kind word inside or beside it simply gets its Name and no type atom, and 'Assert only what the text states' bars inventing one — the mandatory-class rule covers anonymous sk_ witnesses, not a named entity.
